THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 482 CR.PC PRAYING TO QUASH THE FIR,
COMPLAINT AND ENTIRELY OF PROCEEDINGS IN THE CR.NO.15/2024 FOR OFFENCE P/U/S 498A AND SEC. 4 OF THE MUSLIM WOMEN ACT,
2019 AGAINST THE PETITIONERS ON THE FILE OF THE HONBLE XXXIX ADDL. CMM, BENGALURU INSOFAR AS THE PETITIONERS ARE CONCERNED.
 THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER

In this petition, petitioners have sought for the following reliefs:-
" a) Call for the records in the Cr.No. 15/2024 of south East women Police Station for offences under Section 4 of The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage)
Act, 2019 and IPC Section 34 and 498A against the Petitioner on the file of the Hon'ble XXXIX Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru.
b) Quash the FIR, Complaint and entirety of proceedings in the Cr.No.15/2024 of South East Women Police Station for offences under Section 4 of The Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019 and IPC Section 34 and 498A against the Petitioner on the file of the Hon'ble XXXIX Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru
insofar as the Petitioner is concerned.

C) Grant such other relief/s as this Hon'ble Court deems fit to grant in facts and circumstances of the case."

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners - accused Nos. 2 and 3 and learned counsel for 2nd respondent - complainant have filed a Joint Compromise dated 04.02.2025 duly signed by the petitioners, 2nd respondent and their respective counsel.
The same is taken on record.
It is submitted that the complainant in Cr.No.15/2024 and the Petitioners herein have amicably settled all disputes.

To that effect a Memorandum of Settlement dated 07.01.2025 in OS No.329/2024, before the VI Additional Family Judge, Bengaluru,
may be read as part and parcel of this Memo.
A copy of the memorandum of settlement and decree is annexed hereto for the kind perusal of this Hon'ble Court.

2. It is submitted that, the offences in the present case under Section 34 and Section 498A of NC: 2025:KHC:5232 the IPC and Section 4 of the Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019, are compoundable in nature.
